body:
Implemented history grouping and IME composition semantics in the Rust core.

## Files changed
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/history.rs`
  - `Group` now carries `Option<GroupId>`; `History::record` merges consecutive groups with the same `GroupId` (steps/inverse concatenated in order, `selection_after`/`origin`/`bytes` absorbed).
  - Added public `HistoryInfo { can_undo, can_redo, undo_depth, redo_depth, bytes, last_origin }` + `History::info`.
  - Added `History::clear`, `max_groups`, `max_bytes`, `set_limits`; limits trim oldest groups, keep at least one group under a byte budget, and expose configured budgets.
  - Added `EditorState::{history_info, history_limits, clear_history, with_history_limits}`.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/composition.rs`
  - Added `Composition` snapshot (id, original range/content, current text/end, selection before, changed flag).
  - Added state-level `EditorState::{apply_composition, begin_composition, update_composition, commit_composition, cancel_composition, composition_id, is_composing}`.
  - Start captures original content via step inversion; updates run with `add_to_history = false`; commit records exactly one group (forward original→final, inverse final→original) with `Origin::Composition`; cancel restores original text and selection without history.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/transaction_meta.rs`
  - `Transaction::apply_composition` now tracks the step index at Start, disables history for Start/Update, re-enables it on Commit, and truncates composition steps + restores selection on Cancel instead of only clearing.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/transaction.rs`
  - Added `composition_step_start` and `composition_selection` fields.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/mod.rs`
  - `EditorState` now stores `Option<Composition>` plus a deterministic composition counter; re-exports `HistoryInfo`; passes `GroupId` into history records in both `apply` and `apply_owned`.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/apply_owned.rs`
  - Propagates group id, composition snapshot, and counter; byte accounting now includes forward and inverse steps.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/history.rs`, `crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/common/mod.rs` (new)
  - 8 tests: history info/depth/clear, group-count and byte limits plus re-limiting existing history, same-`GroupId` merge (single undo entry), undo/redo selection restore, composition commit as one entry with selection, composition cancel restore, inactive-session errors, and transaction-level composition commit/cancel.

## Verification
- `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked` — green.
- `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` — green.
- `cargo fmt --check` — clean.
- All touched files ≤300 lines; no changes outside `state/` and tests.
